description: This file defines the interface for the main trigger callback and related functions in the engine control firmware. It includes function declarations for handling ignition timing, injection pulses, and engine event processing.

methods.name: initMainEventListener
methods.description: Initializes the main event listener with a shared logger and engine parameters.

methods.name: mainTriggerCallback
methods.description: Handles trigger events, with specific signal type and event index, to process main engine trigger logic.

methods.name: startPrimeInjectionPulse
methods.description: Starts the prime injection pulse in the engine control sequence.

methods.name: showMainHistogram
methods.description: Displays internal histogram data, likely for debugging or diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: startSimultaniousInjection
methods.description: Begins simultaneous fuel injection across cylinders.

methods.name: seTurnPinHigh
methods.description: Sets the specified injection pin signal high.

methods.name: seTurnPinLow
methods.description: Sets the specified injection pin signal low.

methods.name: getFuel
methods.description: Calculates or retrieves the fuel amount based on engine RPM and key state.

methods.name: updatePrimeInjectionPulseState
methods.description: Resets or updates the prime injection pulse state, typically after engine start.
